historical_record.description: A two-story two-family dwelling stood at the front of the lot.
A one-story single-family dwelling stood at the rear of the lot.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition.

The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved the new construction as modified by staff to incorporate a 5-foot setback from the main facade at the second, third and fourth floor levels on the left hand side of the front facade.
